'''Javarican espresso''' was a beverage<ref name="Harvest" /> that originated in the [[Javarica system/Legends|Javarica system]],<ref name="Planetnamia" /> a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Tynquay sector/Legends|Tynquay sector]].<ref name="Tynquay">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> After one midnight on [[Odacer-Faustin]]&mdash;a [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Harvest" /> in the Outer Rim's [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="Esstran">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Odacer-Faustin system/Legends|Odacer-Faustin system]]</ref>&mdash;in [[3645 BBY]], [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] [[Pergus Frode]] sat back in the control booth of the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy]]'s main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] holding a reheated cup of Javarican espresso and a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] showing the ''[[Hot Ships]]'' [[Holomag/Legends|holomag]]. The mechanic, fearful of punishment, had felt obliged to stay up late to watch over the [[Dranok's ship|starship]] of a [[Dranok|bounty hunter]] hired by [[Darth Scabrous]], [[Headmaster/Legends|headmaster]] of the [[Sith academy]]. While Frode took shelter in the warmth of his booth with the beverage and the holomag, he was informed by Scabrous' [[Darth Scabrous' HK droid|HK-series assassin droid]] that the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunter]] would never return, and so he set out to [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenge]] the [[Cruiser/Legends|ship]] for himself.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Javarican espresso appeared in the [[2011]] novel [[Red Harvest (novel)|''Red Harvest'']], written by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Harvest" />
